title: PatientHub: A Unified Framework for Patient Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.11684v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As Large Language Models increasingly power role-playing applications, simulating patients has become a valuable tool for training counselors and scaling therapeutic assessment. However, prior work remains fragmented: existing approaches rely on incompatible, non-standardized profiles, prompts, and evaluation metrics, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and reuse. We introduce PatientHub, a unified and modular framework that standardizes the creation, simulation, and evaluation of LLM-based patients. Our framework provides 16 patient simulators, a graph-based orchestrator for multi-turn, multi-session interactions, and a configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluator that supports multiple rubric types. Via our command-line interface, users can generate patient profiles, run simulations, and apply rubric-driven evaluation at the turn and session level. To demonstrate PatientHub's utility, we compare several supported simulators

translated_title: PatientHub：一个用于患者模拟的统一框架
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地驱动角色扮演应用，模拟患者已成为培训咨询师和扩展治疗评估的宝贵工具。然而，先前的工作仍然分散：现有方法依赖于不兼容、非标准化的配置文件、提示词和评估指标，阻碍了可复现性、公平比较和重用。我们引入了PatientHub，一个统一且模块化的框架，标准化了基于LLM的患者的创建、模拟和评估。我们的框架提供了16个患者模拟器、一个用于多轮、多会话交互的基于图的编排器，以及一个支持多种评分类型的可配置LLM-as-a-judge评估器。通过我们的命令行界面，用户可以在回合和会话级别生成患者配置文件、运行模拟并应用基于评分标准的评估。为展示PatientHub的实用性，我们比较了几个支持的模拟器。
tldr: 本文提出了PatientHub，一个统一且模块化的框架，通过标准化患者模拟的创建、交互和评估流程，解决了现有方法碎片化的问题，并提供了16个模拟器和多级评估工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PatientHub, a unified and modular framework that standardizes patient simulation creation, interaction, and evaluation, addressing fragmentation in existing approaches with 16 simulators and multi-level assessment tools.
